title: Access Evidence Pipeline Spec: Hosted / Dedicated / Private
summary: Working specification for an automated evidence pipeline that collects, normalizes, signs, and exports RBAC and audit evidence to internal artifact stores and SIEMs across hosting modes. Focus is on consistent proof artifacts, minimal PII leakage, and verifiable chains of custody for compliance reviews.
environments: Hosted: Multi-tenant runtime. Evidence must be tenant-scoped (tenant_id hashed), include model and route metadata, and avoid user plaintext where possible. Exports use a dedicated, high-throughput SIEM stream with tenant-scoped routing tags.

Dedicated: Tenant-dedicated GPU pools. Evidence can include node-level telemetry, instance IDs, and GPU allocation snapshots. Artifact packaging must include enrollment tokens and reserved-capacity contract ids for audit correlation.

Private: VPC/on-prem deployments. Evidence collection may be offline or via connector. Requirements emphasize KMS-wrapped signing keys, HSM-backed attestations, and local retention policies with secure upload windows.

policy_templates: service-account-minimal: name=svc-evidence-collector; resources=read:audit_logs,read:metrics; conditions=from-ci-ip && time-window=00:00-23:59; expiry=30d; note=rotate every 7d
vault-rotation-hook: description=automated rotation for signing keys; trigger=key-age>90d OR compromise-flag; actions=rotate-kms-key -> re-sign-index -> notify-compliance
ephemeral-priv-activation: flow=just-in-time elevation via OIDC + ticket; duration=15m; auditor-notify=true; token-binding=client-cert
audit_log_schema_snippets: actor_role=canonical role name from RBAC v2 matrix
tenant_id=customer id hashed with salt for hosted mode
action=canonical action verb (e.g., route.create, model.infer, policy.attach)
resource_id=opaque id, include human-friendly label in metadata
request_id=uuid v4 for the external request
token_hash=sha256 of auth token (never store raw token)
siem_export_mapping: ECS-compatible mapping recommended. Map timestamp->@timestamp, actor_id->user.id, actor_role->user.roles[], tenant_id->labels.tenant_hash, action->event.action, resource_type->event.dataset, resource_id->event.id, outcome->event.outcome, request_id->event.id.request, trace_id->trace.id. Add meta.tags=[hosting:hosted|dedicated|private,env:prod|staging]. Include original raw_json in event.metadata.raw for future repro. Sample exported line: {"@timestamp":"2024-02-15T12:23:34Z", "user.id":"svc-evid-1", "user.roles":["platform-admin"], "labels.tenant_hash":"t-9f3ab", "event.action":"policy.attach", "event.outcome":"success"}
evidence_automation_workflow: 1) Trigger: scheduled harvest or evidence-request ticket. 2) Collect: pull audit logs, RBAC snapshots, policy diffs, kube/instance snapshots, model version manifest. 3) Normalize: transform logs to canonical audit schema, redact PII, compute tenant-hash. 4) Sign: KMS/HSM-sign bundle manifest and include key id. 5) Package: create evidence bundle (manifest.json, logs.ndjson, meta.yml, signatures.sig). 6) Publish: push to evidence-bucket (s3/gcs) and emit SIEM event with bundle pointer. 7) Index: add pointer to internal evidence index (searchable). 8) Retain & Rotate: set retention TTL and schedule re-sign/rotation jobs.
retention_and_verification: Retention baseline: hosted=365 days, dedicated=2 years, private=customer-defined (default 3 years). Verification: provide a verifier tool that checks signature chain, manifest content, and that the bundle contains expected artifact types. Automated weekly verification run with failure tickets.
operational_notes: For hosted mode, avoid exporting full customer prompt text; use redaction hooks that keep token counts and signal quality without PII.
Bundle signing keys are rotated quarterly; older bundles remain verifiable via key rotation metadata and key-history index.
SIEM export must support burst 10k events/min during incident windows; use backpressure queue and durable buffer to avoid data loss.
